errors.bad_request: Something in the form is not right.
errors.invalid_code: That code is not valid. Try the next code from your app.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait 10 minutes and try again.
errors.weak_password: Use a password of at least 12 characters.
errors.invalid_setup_token: The setup token is not correct.
errors.setup_done: Setup has already been completed. Sign in instead.
errors.invalid_current_password: Your current password is not correct.
errors.update_check_failed: Could not reach GitHub to check for updates.
errors.update_in_progress: An update is already in progress.
errors.unknown_version: This version is not available on the selected channel.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on the server.
errors.helper_unavailable: The Kiestoon system service is not running. Run systemctl start kiestoon-helper on the server.
errors.backup_busy: A backup or restore is already running.
errors.helper_failed: The system service could not complete this.
errors.mail_failed: The mail could not be sent.
errors.duplicate: This value is already in use.
errors.invalid_number_length: The number does not fit the number plan.
errors.reserved_number: This number is reserved for emergency calls.
errors.srtp_needs_tls: Encrypted audio (SRTP) needs the TLS transport.
errors.unknown_trunk: One of the trunks does not exist.
errors.renumber_conflict: Some numbers cannot be shortened without a conflict.
errors.asterisk_unavailable: The phone engine (Asterisk) cannot be reached.
errors.auth_needs_tls: Sign-in needs an encrypted connection (TLS or STARTTLS).
errors.no_extension: Your account is not linked to an extension yet. Ask your administrator.
errors.webrtc_disabled: The browser softphone is turned off for your extension.
errors.invalid_audio: This audio could not be used. Upload or record a clear recording of at most a few minutes.
errors.prompt_in_use: This prompt is still used by an IVR or queue.
errors.cannot_change_self: You cannot change your own role or disable your own account.
errors.last_superadmin: There must always be at least one active super admin.
errors.number_out_of_range: This number is outside the range of the number plan for this kind of object.
errors.unknown_member: One of the members is not an existing extension.
errors.unknown_prompt: The selected prompt does not exist.
errors.loop: This destination would send calls back to itself.
errors.sso_denied: Sign-in was cancelled at your identity provider.
errors.sso_disabled: This sign-in method is turned off.
errors.sso_failed: Single sign-on failed. Try again or sign in with your password.
errors.sso_no_account: There is no Kiestoon account for you yet. Ask your administrator to create one.
errors.sso_no_role: Your account has no role in Kiestoon. Ask your administrator to add you to the right group.
errors.sso_state: The sign-in took too long or was opened in another tab. Try again.
errors.sso_unknown: This sign-in method does not exist.
errors.sso_unreachable: The identity provider cannot be reached.

setup.title: Welcome to Kiestoon
setup.subtitle: Let's set up your phone system. This takes about two minutes.
setup.languageHint: Pick the language for the setup. Every user can change it later.
setup.tokenHint: Shown at the end of the installation. Lost it? Run kiestoon setup-token on the server.
setup.organizationHint: Shown in the portal and on phone displays later.
setup.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A sentence of a few words works well.
setup.securityText: Administrators always sign in with a password and a code from an authenticator app, such as Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator or 1Password. You will set it up in the next step.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage your phone system.
login.mfaText: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.

mfa.title: Set up two-factor authentication
mfa.text: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app. Then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key by hand:
mfa.codesText: Each code works once, if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe, such as a password manager. They are only shown now.
mfa.codesSaved: I have saved my recovery codes

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Overview of your phone system
dashboard.restartNeeded: A setting needs a restart of the phone engine. Restart it from
dashboard.phonesHint: Extensions with at least one registered device
dashboard.noTrunks: No trunks yet. Add one to call outside.

soon.title: Coming in phase {{phase}}
soon.text: This part of Kiestoon is planned for phase {{phase}} of the roadmap.

info.title: Info & updates
info.testingHint: Release candidates, to try new features before everyone else.
info.upToDate: You are running the latest version.
info.downgrade: The newest version on this channel is {{version}}, which is older than the version you run. You can switch to it.
info.noReleases: No releases on this channel yet.
info.confirm: Kiestoon makes a backup, installs {{version}} and restarts. The portal is unavailable for about a minute. Continue?
info.adminOnly: Only administrators can change the channel or update.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.subtitle: Internal numbers, SIP accounts and voicemail
extensions.confirmDelete: Delete extension {{number}} ({{name}})? Its voicemail box is removed too.
extensions.name: Name
extensions.emptyText: Add an extension for every person or phone. Kiestoon picks the next free number for you.
extensions.srtpHint: Needs TLS. Most modern phones support it.
extensions.maxContactsHint: For example a desk phone, a softphone and a mobile app.
extensions.outboundCidHint: The number others see. Empty: the route or trunk decides.
extensions.pinHint: 4 to 8 digits. Empty: generated for you.
extensions.vmDeleteHint: The message is only kept in the e-mail.
extensions.sipDetailsText: Enter these details in a phone or softphone. Provisioned phones get them automatically.
extensions.resetConfirm: Make a new SIP password? Phones with the old password stop working until they get the new one.
extensions.pickupGroupHint: *8 picks up calls in the same group. Empty: none.
extensions.allowPremiumHint: Such as 0900 and 0906. Off is safer.
extensions.webrtcHint: The user can call with a headset in the user portal.

trunks.title: Trunks & routes
trunks.subtitle: Connections to your telecom provider and how calls are routed
trunks.name: Name
trunks.callerIdHint: Default number shown to people you call. Must be one of your own numbers.
trunks.emptyText: A trunk connects Kiestoon to your telecom provider, so you can call outside and receive calls.
trunks.authUsernameHint: Only when your provider gives a separate one.
trunks.matchIpsHint: Calls from these addresses are accepted as calls from this trunk. One per line.

notes.generic: Fill in the details from your provider.
notes.ip: Ask your provider which IP addresses they send calls from, and give them the public IP address of this server.
notes.voipgrid: Create a SIP account in the VoIPGRID portal and use its account ID and password.
notes.kpn: KPN connects on IP address. Fill in the IP addresses from your KPN order.
notes.telnyx: Create a credential connection in the Telnyx portal. TLS on port 5061 is recommended.
notes.twilio: Create an Elastic SIP trunk, add the public IP of this server to its access control list and use your termination URI as host.

routes.name: Name
routes.didHint: Your number as the provider sends it. Empty: every number not matched by another route.
routes.cidPrefixHint: Shown before the caller name, for example "Sales: ".
routes.emptyInbound: No inbound routes yet. Calls on your numbers go nowhere until you add one.
routes.emptyOutbound: No outbound routes yet. Add one to call outside.
routes.inboundText: Decide where calls on your phone numbers go.
routes.outboundText: Routes are tried from top to bottom. The first route with a matching pattern is used. 112 always works, without a route.
routes.patternsHint: X is any digit, Z is 1-9, N is 2-9, [1-5] is a range and . means one or more digits. Prefix is removed, prepend is added.
routes.trunkOrder: Tried in this order. The next trunk is used when one fails.
routes.callerIdHint: Overrides the trunk's caller ID for this route. An extension's own caller ID always wins.

phones.title: Phones & provisioning
phones.subtitle: Desk phones that configure themselves
phones.provText: Point your phones or the DHCP server (option 66) at this address. Phones then fetch their accounts and keys from Kiestoon. The address contains the provisioning password, so keep it private.
phones.serverHint: The host name or IP address phones use to reach this server.
phones.adminPasswordHint: Set on every phone, for its own web interface.
phones.emptyText: Add a phone by its MAC address. It is on the label at the back of the phone.
phones.label: Label
phones.keysHint: Line keys and BLF keys that show the status of colleagues. Grandstream phones get their accounts only for now.
phones.noKeys: This model has no programmable keys.

firewall.title: Firewall
firewall.subtitle: Who can reach the phone system
firewall.noHelper: The Kiestoon system service is not running, so the firewall cannot be changed.
firewall.pending: Checking that you can still reach the portal… The change is undone automatically within 90 seconds if not.
firewall.rolledBack: The last change was undone because the portal could not be reached afterwards.
firewall.enableHint: Blocks everything except the portal, SIP and audio ports.
firewall.sipOpenHint: Needed for phones that connect from anywhere. Not recommended.
firewall.privateSipHint: Phones in the office network can always register.
firewall.whitelistHint: IP addresses or networks allowed to use SIP, one per line. Trunk addresses are added automatically.
firewall.adminHint: Networks that may open the portal. Empty: everyone. Your address is {{ip}}.
firewall.lockout: Your address {{ip}} is not in this list. You will lock yourself out.
firewall.f2bHint: Blocks addresses after repeated failed sign-ins on SIP or the portal.
firewall.safeMode: Safe mode: undone after 90 seconds if you lose access

mail.title: Mail server
mail.subtitle: How Kiestoon sends voicemail and notifications
mail.enabledHint: Voicemail e-mails and alerts are queued while this is off.
mail.noTlsWarn: Without encryption, passwords and messages travel readable over the network.
mail.skipVerifyHint: Only for an internal server with its own certificate.
mail.notifyHint: For failed backups and other problems.
mail.testText: Save first, then send a test e-mail to check the settings.

backups.title: Backups
backups.subtitle: Encrypted backups to your own server, and restore
backups.noHelper: The Kiestoon system service is not running, so backups cannot run.
backups.restoreRunning: A restore is running. The portal restarts in a moment.
backups.name: Name
backups.emptyText: Add an FTP, FTPS, SFTP or SCP server. Kiestoon encrypts everything before it leaves this server.
backups.testCreated: Connection to {{name}} works. A new encrypted backup store was created.
backups.repoKeyHint: Without this key a backup cannot be restored on a new server. Store it in a password manager.
backups.confirmDelete: Delete location {{name}}? The backups on the server stay where they are.
backups.scheduleHint: Every day, with one full backup per week.
backups.allTargets: Runs for every location that is on.
backups.ftpWarn: Plain FTP sends the password unencrypted. The backup itself is always encrypted.
backups.scpHint: SCP uses the same SSH connection as SFTP.
backups.implicitTlsHint: Usually port 990. Off: explicit TLS (AUTH TLS) on port 21.
backups.passwordOrKey: Or use a private key below.
backups.privateKeyHint: Optional. Paste an OpenSSH key without a passphrase.
backups.pathHint: Folder on the server where the backups are stored.
backups.enabledHint: Include this location in scheduled backups.
backups.encryption: Kiestoon creates a strong encryption key for this location. You can view it later.
backups.noSnapshots: No snapshots on this location yet.
backups.restoreWarn: Everything on this server is replaced with the backup from {{time}}. Calls are interrupted and the portal restarts. The current data is kept on the server as a safety copy.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Number plan, emergency calls, network and phone engine
settings.restartNeeded: Some changes take effect after a restart of the phone engine.
settings.applyError: The configuration could not be applied: {{error}}
settings.planConflicts: These numbers cannot be shortened: {{numbers}}. Change them first.
settings.planPhones: Provisioned phones pick up their new number automatically. Others must be changed by hand.
settings.planNoChanges: No extension needs a new number.
settings.emergencyAlways: 112 and 911 always work, from every extension, without a route and even when a trunk limit is reached.
settings.emergencyCidHint: A number on which you can be called back, tied to your address. Empty: the trunk's caller ID.
settings.emergencyTrunksHint: The first trunk is tried first.
settings.emergencyAll: No order set: every trunk is tried.
settings.externalAddressHint: Public IP or host name, when this server is behind NAT. Empty: no NAT.
settings.localNetsHint: Networks that are not behind NAT, one per line.
settings.portsHint: Changing a port needs a restart of the phone engine.
settings.codecsHint: In order of preference, for example g722,alaw,ulaw.
settings.nationalCidHint: Shows +31 20 … as 020 …, so calling back works.
settings.restartText: Restart when no calls are active, or now. Restarting now ends every active call.

hints.superadmin: Full control, including other super admins.
hints.admin: Manages the phone system. Signs in with MFA.
hints.reception: Sees live calls and queues, signs agents in and out and switches day and night mode.
hints.user: Manages their own phone in the user portal.

audio.convertFailed: This file could not be read as audio.
audio.micDenied: The browser has no access to a microphone.
audio.hint: Any audio file works (MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG). It is converted in your browser to telephone quality (8 kHz mono).

ringGroups.title: Ring groups
ringGroups.subtitle: Ring several phones at once or one after another, for example for sales or support.
ringGroups.emptyText: A ring group rings a team on one number.
ringGroups.cidPrefixHint: Shown before the caller's name, so you know which number was called.
ringGroups.externalHint: For example a mobile phone. External members cost an outgoing call.
ringGroups.skipBusyHint: Do not ring members who are already on a call.

strategyHints.simultaneous: Every member rings at the same time. The first to answer gets the call.
strategyHints.sequential: Members ring one after another in the order below.
strategyHints.rotating: Like one by one, but each call starts at the next member.
strategyHints.paging: Phones answer automatically on the speaker. Only for extensions.

queues.title: Call queues
queues.subtitle: Callers wait in line with music until an agent is free.
queues.emptyText: A queue spreads calls over agents and lets callers wait.
queues.agentsHint: Dynamic agents sign in and out themselves (portal or *45). Static agents are always signed in.
queues.overflow: When the queue is full or too slow
queues.wrapupHint: Seconds after a call before the agent gets the next one.
queues.greetingHint: Played once when the caller enters the queue.
queues.musicHint: default unless you added your own class.
queues.announcePositionHint: Tell callers where they are in line.
queues.joinEmpty: Accept callers when no agent is signed in
queues.joinEmptyHint: Off: callers go straight to the overflow destination.
queues.recordHint: Every answered call in this queue is recorded.

strategyHints.rrmemory: Agents take turns, starting after the last one who got a call.
strategyHints.ringall: All free agents ring at once.
strategyHints.leastrecent: The agent who has been idle longest rings first.
strategyHints.fewestcalls: The agent with the fewest calls today rings first.
strategyHints.linear: Agents ring in a fixed order.
strategyHints.wrandom: Random, with a higher penalty giving a lower chance.

ivr.title: IVR builder
ivr.subtitle: Digital receptionist: "Press 1 for sales, 2 for support."
ivr.builderSubtitle: Pick a key on the keypad and choose where it goes.
ivr.emptyText: Build a menu that callers navigate with their keypad.
ivr.promptHint: Upload or record prompts under Voice prompts.
ivr.directDialHint: Callers who know the extension can dial it directly.
ivr.keypadHint: Lit keys are in use. Press a key to add or edit it.
ivr.label: Label
ivr.labelHint: Only shown here, to keep the flow readable.
ivr.selectKey: Select a key or the no-input branch to edit it.
ivr.noInputHint: Used when the caller presses nothing or a key that is not in use, after the menu played {{retries}} extra times.

timeConditions.title: Time conditions
timeConditions.subtitle: Route calls by opening hours and holidays, with a day/night switch.
timeConditions.emptyText: Send calls to the team during office hours and to voicemail outside them.
timeConditions.rangesHint: Times use the time zone in Settings. A lunch break is a second range, for example 13:00 to 17:30.
timeConditions.useHolidaysHint: Uses the holiday calendar on the Holidays tab.
timeConditions.dutchHolidaysHint: Dates move with Easter and are calculated every year.
timeConditions.customHolidaysHint: For example a company outing or the days between Christmas and New Year.

conferences.title: Conference rooms
conferences.subtitle: Meet by phone: everybody dials the same number.
conferences.emptyText: A conference room is a number that several people dial at once.
conferences.waitAdminHint: Participants hear music until someone joins with the host PIN.

prompts.title: Voice prompts
prompts.subtitle: Announcements for IVR menus and queues. Upload a file or record one in the browser.
prompts.emptyText: Record a welcome message, for example "Welcome to … Press 1 for sales."
prompts.replaceHint: Leave the audio empty to only rename the prompt.

recordings.title: Recordings
recordings.subtitle: Recorded calls and meetings. Old recordings are removed automatically (see Call features).
recordings.confirmDelete: Delete this recording? This cannot be undone.
recordings.emptyText: Recordings appear here after a recorded call, or when someone pressed *1 during a call.

users.title: Users & roles
users.subtitle: Who may sign in, with which role, and which extension is theirs.
users.emailHint: Used to match single sign-on accounts.
users.extensionHint: Gives access to the user portal for this extension.
users.newPasswordHint: Leave empty to keep the current password.
users.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Leave empty for accounts that only use single sign-on.
users.enabledHint: A disabled account cannot sign in.
users.resetMfaConfirm: Reset two-factor authentication for {{name}}? They set it up again at the next sign-in.

sso.title: Single sign-on
sso.subtitle: Sign in with Microsoft Entra ID, Google or any OpenID Connect provider.
sso.emptyText: Add Microsoft Entra ID so people sign in with their work account.
sso.redirectHint: Register this redirect URI (type Web) in the app registration at your identity provider.
sso.buttonNameHint: Shown as "Sign in with …" on the sign-in page.
sso.secretKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored secret.
sso.groupsClaimHint: In Entra ID: add a groups claim to the token configuration.
sso.roleMapHint: Members of a group get its role. The highest role wins. For Entra ID use the group's object ID.
sso.defaultRoleHint: No access refuses people that are in none of the groups.
sso.autoCreateHint: At the first sign-in. Off: an administrator creates the account first (same email address).
sso.trustMfaHint: Admins who signed in with SSO do not need a second Kiestoon code. Enforce MFA at the provider (Conditional Access).

issuerHints.entra: Replace <tenant-id> with the directory (tenant) ID from the Entra admin center.
issuerHints.keycloak: Your Keycloak address with the realm name.
issuerHints.authentik: Ends with the slug of the application.

features.title: Call features & fraud
features.subtitle: Parking, recording and protection against toll fraud.
features.parkingSlotsHint: Dial 70 to park; the call goes to 71 to {{last}}.
features.parkingTimeoutHint: A parked call that nobody picks up rings back at the person who parked it.
features.recordingDaysHint: 0 keeps them forever. Mind the GDPR (AVG) retention rules.
features.recordingBeepHint: Callers hear a short beep every 15 seconds.
features.fraudText: Limits what an extension may dial and raises the alarm on unusual traffic, so a stolen password does not cost a fortune.
features.premiumPrefixesHint: Blocked for extensions without permission. Comma separated.
features.perHour: Per hour. 0 turns the alert off.
features.alertEmailHint: Empty: the notification address under Mail server.
features.blockOnAlert: Block all outbound calls on an alert
features.blockOnAlertHint: Emergency calls stay possible. Unlock here after checking.

codes.voicemailAny: Listen to any mailbox (asks for the number)
codes.forwardOn: Forward all calls to a number
codes.dndToggle: Do not disturb on or off
codes.queueToggle: Sign in or out of all your queues
codes.queueToggleOne: Sign in or out of one queue
codes.groupPickup: Pick up a call ringing in your group
codes.directedPickup: Pick up a call ringing at an extension
codes.intercom: Intercom: the other phone answers on the speaker
codes.recordToggle: Start or stop recording during a call
codes.dayNight: Switch a time condition between day and night

reception.title: Switchboard
reception.subtitle: Live queues, colleagues and the day/night switch.

softphone.title: Softphone
softphone.offText: Call and answer with your headset, right here in the browser. The browser asks for the microphone once.
softphone.failedText: The softphone could not connect. Check that the browser may use the microphone and try again.
softphone.insecureText: The softphone needs a secure connection. Open the portal over https.

portal.dndHint: Callers hear busy or go to your voicemail.
portal.toMobileHint: All calls go to your mobile until you stop it.
portal.forwardAlwaysHint: Your phone does not ring at all.
portal.forwardBusyHint: When you are already on a call.
portal.forwardNoAnswerHint: After your ring time. Replaces voicemail.
portal.followMeHint: Your phone rings first; then the numbers below ring as well.
portal.followMeConfirmHint: Stops a mobile voicemail from taking the call.
portal.scheduleHint: Outside these hours your calls go somewhere else, for example your colleague or voicemail.
portal.queuesGroupsHint: Sign in to your queues and see who is available in your groups.
portal.noGroups: You are not in a ring group.
portal.colleaguesHint: See who is available. Click a colleague to call.
portal.viaSoftphone: Calls with the softphone in this browser.
portal.viaDeskphone: Your desk phone rings first; pick it up and the call is set up.
portal.deskphoneRinging: Your phone is ringing. Pick it up to call {{number}}.
portal.devicesHint: Use your extension in the browser, an app or on your desk phone.
portal.softphoneText: The softphone works in this browser with any headset. It keeps running while you use the portal.
portal.softphoneDisabled: The softphone is turned off for your extension. Ask your administrator.
portal.sipAppText: Settings for a SIP app such as Linphone, Zoiper or Groundwire.
portal.qrAlt: QR code with the SIP address
portal.noPhonesText: Phones that are provisioned for your extension appear here, so you can set their keys.
portal.keysSaved: Saved. The phone picks up the new keys at its next restart or provisioning check.
portal.noExtensionText: Your account is not linked to an extension yet. Ask your administrator to link one under Users & roles.

voicemail.title: Voicemail
voicemail.subtitle: Messages, greetings and settings of your mailbox.
voicemail.emptyText: New voicemail appears here and is also sent by email when that is on.
voicemail.disabledText: Voicemail is turned off for your extension.
voicemail.greetingsHint: Without your own greeting callers hear a standard message with your number.

kindHints.busy: When you are on another call.
kindHints.greet: Your name, used in standard messages.
kindHints.temp: Overrides the others while it exists, for example during a holiday.

voicemail.newPinHint: 4 to 10 digits, for listening by phone (*97). Leave empty to keep it.
voicemail.dialIn: Listen by phone: dial *97 from your own phone.
